title: UD-GNN: Uncertainty-aware Debiased Training on Semi-Homophilous Graphs

problem.claim: Most GNNs rely on homophily and fail to generalize well to graphs containing heterophilous connections; under mixed local connectivity, they are biased toward homophilous nodes and perform poorly on heterophilous nodes.

gap.claim: Global homophily or heterophily measurements cannot describe the local connectivity of individual nodes.

contributions.claim: An Uncertainty-aware Debiasing framework retains the biased model's knowledge on certain nodes and compensates for nodes with high uncertainty.
The framework estimates GNN output uncertainty to recognize heterophilous nodes, then prunes biased parameters for certain nodes and retrains the pruned parameters on high-uncertainty nodes.
The framework is applied to homophilous GNNs including GCN and GAT, and heterophilous GNNs including Mixhop and GPR-GNN.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Experiments were conducted on synthetic and benchmark datasets.
The authors report that the debiased model consistently performs better and narrows the performance gap between homophilous and heterophilous nodes.

narrative_sequence.summary: GNNs commonly depend on homophily and struggle with heterophilous graphs.
Global homophily measures do not capture node-level connectivity, while real graphs can mix homophilous and heterophilous nodes.
GNNs are biased toward homophilous nodes and lose performance on heterophilous nodes.
Uncertainty-aware debiasing identifies uncertain or heterophilous nodes and retrains selected parameters to reduce bias.
Experiments across multiple GNN families and dataset types report improved performance and a smaller node-group performance gap.

source_observation.claim: Mixed local connectivity can cause a model to favor homophilous nodes and underperform on heterophilous nodes.

interpretation.claim: Aggregate graph-level structure measures may hide subgroup-specific failure modes.

application.claim: Evaluate model behavior across structurally distinct node groups and inspect uncertainty when subgroup performance diverges.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish that uncertainty-based debiasing applies beyond the evaluated GNNs or datasets.

unknowns: Which parameters are pruned and retrained.
Dataset details, metrics, baselines, and quantitative results.
Whether the reported gains are independently verified.
